subject.title: Bug: License incorrectly displayed as MIT-0 instead of MIT

question: Should ClawHub continue enforcing a fixed MIT-0 license for all published skills, or support declared MIT metadata for skills like `openclaw-workspace-sync`?
rationale: Current main intentionally encodes fixed MIT-0 licensing, but the reporter's package metadata and the open linked PR point toward declared-license support; automation cannot choose the legal/product contract.

options.title: Support declared MIT licenses
options.body: Proceed with reviewing and narrowing https://github.com/openclaw/clawhub/pull/2964 so publish/import/API/CLI/UI/backfill surfaces consistently preserve MIT alongside MIT-0.

options.title: Reaffirm fixed MIT-0 policy
options.body: Keep the platform-wide MIT-0 model and resolve this issue by clarifying publisher consent and any required remediation for packages whose upstream metadata says MIT.

options.title: Pause for legal review
options.body: Keep this issue and the linked PR open without code changes until maintainers decide the license contract and migration obligations.

recommendation.title: Reaffirm fixed MIT-0 policy
recommendation.body: Keep the platform-wide MIT-0 model and resolve this issue by clarifying publisher consent and any required remediation for packages whose upstream metadata says MIT.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is tied to the original MIT-0 enforcement commit and the prior product-direction comment closing the earlier license metadata PR.
